headline.title: A quiet Sunday, as far as the archivist could confirm
headline.quip: Nothing verifiably collapsed today, which the archivist is treating as a day of rest rather than a clerical error. The infrastructure kept its Sunday hours.
headline.summary: No disruption could be verified against two independent reputable sources for this date, so the archivist is filing a calm door.

reasons: Possible disruptions on this date (a Sunday-night Microsoft 365 user-report spike, a reported AMS-IX packet-loss incident) were found only in snippets; the source pages could not be opened (hosts blocked in the session), so the verification bar was not met.
The owner may want to check whether a verifiable event was missed before this calm door goes live.
